item.title: El-Sayed Gains Momentum in Michigan Senate Race
item.description: Bay County, Michigan, executive Jim Barcia told Newsmax on Thursday that the race is tight, but El-Sayed appears to be gaining ground.

item.title: Trump admin cannot refuse detained illegal immigrants a chance for release on bond, appeals court rules
item.description: A federal appeals court ruled against the Trump administration's expanded mandatory detention policy adopted as part of its mass deportation plan.

item.title: S.C. AG Wilson to Newsmax: Fraudsters Going to Prison in Crackdown
item.description: South Carolina Attorney General Alan Wilson told Newsmax on Thursday that the Justice Department's new National Fraud Enforcement Division is signaling a crackdown on fraud.
